title: Hatsune Miku — Happy Anniversary! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, that should be all the ingredients.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and all the equipment we need is set up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope your anniversary cake turns out well.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's gonna take some time, so we better get started now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're right.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku, are you sure you don't want me and KAITO to help?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, if you did, then there's no way it could go wrong.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But don't worry. We'll make sure we don't waste the ingredients by working together and following the recipe to a T.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you say so... It is your anniversary, so I guess we should just let you do what you want to.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And so, we're counting on you, An, as the experienced cook in the room.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ahaha...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I don't really get what's going on, but I have a bad feeling about this...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, let's start by sifting out some cake flour.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I can do that since I did it when we baked at school.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, Kohane!
I'll leave that to you then!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure! Then I'll do it over on that table so I don't get flour on anyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Got it!
Which leaves us to make the meringue I guess.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I actually know how to make a meringue. KAITO taught me and Toya when we were making cupcakes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? I'll leave that to you two then!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure. I'll take the hand mixer then.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Luka...! Luka...!)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Got it, I'm on it♪)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: An, I'll keep an eye on those two, so please hand out the rest of the work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you, Luka. Though, the only job left is...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: “Beat egg yolks with a hand mixer until fluffy and light.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I brought a hand mixer from home, so you can use that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Akito, do you know how to use a hand mixer?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How to use it? You just flip the switch and make sure everything gets evenly mixed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, I guess you also gotta make sure the mixer doesn't bump against the bowl and send everything fly—

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Whoa! Miku, stop stop stooop! The mixer's scraping against the bowl!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Like that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Like that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: W-Well it's not easy to never hit it even once, so let's just be careful!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh yeah, did you add the sugar already?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm about to. You add it three times, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yep, that's right! Wait...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh, Miku? Just to be clear, you know that doesn't mean three bowlfuls, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya, Miku & Luka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An & Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Luka! You shouldn't be confused about it too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: B-But, Miku said it so confidently!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I'm gonna go help Kohane. It's gotta be less chaotic over there.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I just put the batter in the oven.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Got it, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm excited to see how it turns out. I hope it bakes evenly.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It'll be okay... It should be...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Um... Good work, everyone...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We have drinks here for everyone, so why don't you take a break?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh yeah! Maybe the show's started already.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What show?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The Miku from our world is putting on an anniversary show. It's being streamed, so you can even watch it on a phone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nice. Can you show me?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna see too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe, let's all watch together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo! Thanks, An!
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We only just got started, but everyone's already so excited!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I've been so excited in the lead-up to today.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <After all, we get to announce the results of our “Who's Your Favorite Miku?” poll.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You'll know this if you watched the trailer, but we put out a poll asking for song requests for today's set list.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <And the theme was “Who's Your Favorite Miku?”!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Thank you so much for all the requests!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <We asked you to write reasons for the songs you chose, and I was moved at how some of you poured out your hearts as if you were writing a letter to me.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <To tell you the truth, the plan was to sing the top ten requested songs from that poll.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <But after reading all your messages, that didn't feel like enough.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <And so, I put together a special medley of the songs that got the most passionate requests♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “Favorite Miku”...? I like that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We still have time until the cake is done baking, right? Let's take this chance to watch the show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm, if only we had something to wave like those glow sticks the people in the venue have.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, what if we waved the ladles?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Or the spatulas!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, don't treat my kitchen like your toybox.

rows.Speaker: Luka & KAITO
rows.Line: Yes ma'am...

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Hahaha.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Everyone, they're about to announce #10 from the poll.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is exciting. I wonder what kind of song it is.
